name: Uscis
demographics: The facility primarily serves immigrant populations and their families across diverse age groups and income levels throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. Visitors typically include working-age adults (25-55 years old) seeking employment authorization, naturalization, or family-based immigration services, as well as employers verifying employment eligibility. The trade area encompasses a multicultural demographic with significant Hispanic, Asian, and African populations, reflecting Fort Worth's diverse immigrant communities seeking pathways to permanent residence and citizenship.
description: Located at 5932 Quebec Street in Fort Worth, Texas, this facility serves as a United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) office, providing essential immigration and naturalization services to the Fort Worth community. As an official government facility, it offers a comprehensive range of services including green card applications, naturalization processing, employment authorization documents, and family-based immigration petitions. The office serves as a critical resource for immigrants navigating the complex U.S. immigration system, offering everything from asylum applications to citizenship education programs. With its convenient Fort Worth location, the facility provides accessible government services to residents throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. The USCIS office maintains the highest standards of security and professionalism, ensuring that all visitors receive accurate information and efficient processing of their immigration matters.
summary: This Fort Worth location houses a United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) office, providing essential immigration and naturalization services to the local community. The facility offers comprehensive government services including green card applications, citizenship processing, and employment authorization.
